metadata.harness_note: Per Issues/analysis-execute-orchestrator-dispatch-limitation.md, sub-agents in this harness do not have the Agent dispatch tool at runtime. The parent (user-facing) orchestrator executes the dispatches below by invoking each target_agent with its feedback_brief. finalize-reconciler does not dispatch directly.

ac_cs_9_wrapping_intent_note: AC-CS-9 ('cold-cache build doesn't need a C++ toolchain') is preserved under F2's npm install path. The env-var GITNEXUS_SKIP_OPTIONAL_GRAMMARS=1 does the same load-bearing work under npm (suppresses npm's vendored tree-sitter grammar build) as it was claimed to do under uvx (suppresses a Python C-extension build that never actually existed for this package). Re-authoring agents MUST preserve AC-CS-9's semantic guarantee. They are changing the install mechanism only; they are NOT re-deriving or weakening AC-CS-9. The verify-at-execution check (tasks.json T0.4 + AT-bound L1 probe) still asserts: no cc/g++/cargo in the install-process tree. The probe condition is install-command-agnostic; only the install command being probed changes (uvx form → npm/npx form).
